title: x-opencdc channel extension for the WSS + AsyncAPI Protocol Binding (0.3.0)
description: Endpoint declarations for the OpenCDC WSS + AsyncAPI binding. These are normative for the endpoint (Section 6.3). They are not stream declarations; those live in STREAM_METADATA. Clients MUST ignore members they do not recognise.

bindingVersion.description: Binding document version, <wire>.<revision>, without any -wip suffix.

subprotocols.description: Subprotocols this endpoint accepts; MUST include opencdc.json (B-WSA-3).

operationalMode.description: Fixed in this revision (5.6). Ephemeral Mode is deferred.

replayWindow.description: ISO 8601 duration (e.g. P7D) or a URI of the retention policy (B-WSA-28).

maxEventBytes.description: Largest serialized event, UTF-8 bytes before transport compression (B-WSA-15).

maxMessageBytes.description: Largest batch message after reassembly, UTF-8 bytes; MUST be >= maxEventBytes (B-WSA-15).

maxBatchLingerMs.description: Upper bound on how long an event waits in an unfilled batch (B-WSA-49). MUST be less than heartbeat_interval_seconds * 1000.

closeCodes.description: Endpoint-specific close codes beyond Section 5.8, in the 4000-4999 range and not colliding with the binding's codes.
